About Unilever

With 3.4 billion people in over 190 countries using our products every day, Unilever is a business that makes a real impact on the world. Work on brands that are loved and improve the lives of our consumers and the communities around us. We are driven by our purpose: to make sustainable living commonplace, and it is our belief that doing business the right way drives superior performance. At the heart of what we do is our people – we believe that when our people work with purpose, we will create a better business and a better world.

At Unilever, your career will be a unique journey, grounded in our inclusive, collaborative, and flexible working environment. We don’t believe in the ‘one size fits all’ approach and instead we will equip you with the tools you need to shape your own future.

Job Summary:

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Business Integrity Officer to join our team in Indonesia. This role is crucial in upholding Unilever's commitment to ethical business practices and ensuring compliance with all relevant laws, regulations, and internal policies within the Indonesian market.

Job Responsibilities:

• Develop, implement, and maintain a robust business integrity and ethics program in line with Unilever's global standards and local regulations.
• Conduct regular risk assessments to identify potential integrity breaches, compliance gaps, and areas for improvement within business operations.
• Lead and conduct thorough investigations into alleged breaches of the Code of Business Principles, company policies, and relevant laws, ensuring objectivity, fairness, and adherence to legal requirements.
• Provide expert advice and guidance to all levels of employees on ethical dilemmas, conflict of interest situations, and compliance with anti-bribery and corruption laws.
• Design and deliver comprehensive training programs on business integrity, ethics, and compliance for employees across various functions and levels.
• Monitor and report on the effectiveness of integrity programs, identifying trends, and recommending corrective actions to senior management.
• Collaborate closely with legal, internal audit, HR, and other relevant departments to ensure a coordinated approach to integrity and compliance.
• Stay abreast of changes in Indonesian laws and regulations pertaining to business ethics, anti-corruption, and corporate governance, adapting company policies and procedures accordingly.
• Act as a trusted point of contact for employees to report concerns and seek guidance on ethical matters.
• Represent Unilever in discussions with external stakeholders, including regulators and industry associations, on matters related to business integrity.

Job Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Law, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field. A Master's degree or professional certification (e.g., CFE, CCEP) is a strong plus.
• Minimum of 7-10 years of experience in business integrity, compliance, internal audit, legal, or a related role, preferably within a multinational corporation in Indonesia.
• In-depth knowledge of Indonesian anti-corruption laws (e.g., UU Tipikor), corporate governance regulations, and other relevant business laws.
• Proven experience in conducting complex investigations, including interviewing, evidence gathering, and report writing.
• Strong understanding of ethical principles and their application in a business context.
• Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills, with the ability to influence and engage stakeholders at all levels.
• Fluency in both Bahasa Indonesia and English (written and spoken) is essential.
• Demonstrated ability to maintain confidentiality, exercise sound judgment, and act with the highest level of integrity.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail.
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

Founded in 1966, Kalbe Farma (Kalbe) is the largest publicly-listed pharmaceutical company in Southeast Asia. As of end 2023, Kalbe’s extensive healthcare ecosystem encompasses a network of 47 companies, including subsidiaries, joint ventures, and associates, all driven by a dedicated workforce of 16,795 employees.

Guided by a vision to become the country’s best global healthcare company, Kalbe offers a comprehensive healthcare solution through its four key business divisions: prescription pharmaceuticals, consumer health, nutrition, and distribution & logistics. Within these divisions, Kalbe manages a diverse portfolio reinforced by a robust distribution network that serves over one million outlets across Indonesia’s vast archipelago.

On the international stage, Kalbe has established a strong presence in ASEAN countries, as well as regions spanning East and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. Kalbe’s business ventures are supported by best in- class research and development capabilities, developed through strategic alliances with many international partners. The Company is deeply involved in cutting-edge areas such as drug delivery systems, cancer treatment, stem cell research, and biotechnology.
